dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「今日で授業も最後だけど、ちゃんとしっかり
　勉強するんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Today's the last day of classes, so make sure you take your
work seriously."
dialogues.text:
"Today's the last day of classes, so make sure you take your
work seriously."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生らしからぬ真面目な言葉でＨＲを締めく
くる。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei ended HR with that serious bit of advice.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei ended HR with that serious bit of advice.

dialogues.en: It's been a long, hard journey...
dialogues.text: It's been a long, hard journey...

dialogues.jp: だが、それも今日で最後だ。

（退屈な授業も今日が最後だと思うと、まあ、
　真面目に受けてやるか、という気になるかな）
dialogues.en:
"(Since today's the last day of these boring classes, I
might as well take it seriously for once.)"
dialogues.text:
"(Since today's the last day of these boring classes, I
might as well take it seriously for once.)"

dialogues.jp:
まだ一日の始めだというのに、こころはウキウ
キ気分だ。
dialogues.en: With just one day left, I was feeling gracious.
dialogues.text: With just one day left, I was feeling gracious.

dialogues.jp:
いよいよ最終日が始まった。最終日だと思うと、
次の授業も楽しみになってくるから、我ながら
調子がいい気もする。
dialogues.en:
The final day of classes had finally arrived. Since it was
the final day, I figured I'd make things easier for the
teachers and actually listen to class for once.
dialogues.text:
The final day of classes had finally arrived. Since it was
the final day, I figured I'd make things easier for the
teachers and actually listen to class for once.

dialogues.jp: さて、次の授業は何かな♪
dialogues.en: Now, what class is up next.♪
dialogues.text: Now, what class is up next.♪
